repo.running.py:
"""Running totals over readings."""


def running_level(readings):
    """Return the running total of level after each reading, in order."""
    out = []
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(readings) - 1):
        total += readings[i].level
        out.append(total)
    return out


def final_level(readings):
    """Return the total level of all readings, or 0 when there are none."""
    totals = running_level(readings)
    return totals[-1] if totals else 0
